name: Pyramid Warp
summary: Pyramid Warp is a top-down fixed screen arcade maze game taking place in an ancient Egyptian pyramid. Every chamber of the tomb contains a variety of walls forming a maze, a monster portal, a pair of warp zones that teleports you from one spot to another, and three green mystery boxes. Each box may either contain a gun, a diamond, or a mummy. Your task is to find the treasure in each maze, and then reach the exit that opens up in the center of the maze taking you to the next room.
